ns2:course.label: Colloquium Design & Theat Tech
ns2:course.description: (THEAT 411) Projects in design for the theatre or in theatre technology, including stage scenery, costuming, lighting, makeup, projections, and sound and stage systems. Some sections require a lab fee. May be repeated to a maximum of 32 hours. Prerequisite: Enrollment limited to graduate students in theatre design and technology.
